quizName:
Hardest Questions in District of columbia
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road will curve ahead.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause you to crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that takes your attention, eyes, or hands away from driving.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is coming. This sign is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. It tells drivers to slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Round signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells drivers that a railroad crossing is coming and they should watch for trains.

questions.question: On a freeway, if you miss your turn or exit, you should:

options.text: Continue driving until you reach the next turn, exit, or safe place to turn around
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue driving until you reach the next turn, exit, or safe place to turn around
questions.explanation: If you miss your turn or exit, do not back up. Go to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around. Backing up on a freeway is illegal.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is a traffic law sign. It tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: If you become drowsy while driving, you should:
questions.explanation: If you feel tired while driving, go to the nearest rest stop to take a nap, stretch, or let someone else drive. Caffeine pills and energy drinks are not safe replacements for rest.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic going in the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: If you encounter an aggressive driver, you should:
questions.explanation: When you meet an aggressive driver, the safest choice is to get out of their way. Do not compete with other drivers. Respect all road users and follow traffic rules.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns you that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge from the right into your lane. Be prepared to allow merging traffic in safely.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a phone.
Changing a radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers must focus fully on driving. You make about 200 decisions for every mile you travel. Any extra task takes your attention away from the road and creates danger.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you while driving?
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows the brain areas that control judgment and self-control. It makes you feel overly confident. Alcohol also slows your reaction time, coordination, and balance. It hurts your vision and ability to judge distance, making it hard to react safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with a traffic light. It tells drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns drivers that people may be crossing the road. Stay alert.

questions.question: You feel angry after something at work. When you get to your car, you should:

options.text: Play the radio loudly so you won't think about it.
Drive fast on the highway to let off steam.
Wait a few minutes to calm down before you drive.
Stop at a bar for drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait a few minutes to calm down before you drive.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, take time to calm down before driving. Letting anger control your driving is dangerous to you and others on the road.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even if no other traffic is visible.
Signal only if other traffic is visible.
Signal only in heavy night traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if no other traffic is visible.
questions.explanation: Always signal when changing lanes, turning, or pulling away from the curb. Make this a habit. Do not skip signaling just because you do not see other cars.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. Wherever this sign is posted, U-turns are not permitted.

questions.question: If you have an argument with another person and feel angry, what should you do?

options.text: Play the radio loudly while driving so you won't think about the argument.
Wait a few minutes to calm down before you drive.
Drive on the interstate to release stress.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait a few minutes to calm down before you drive.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions make it harder to drive safely. If you are angry, excited, scared, worried, or sad, take time to calm down before driving. You need to focus your full attention on the road without thinking about upsetting things.

questions.question: Drivers should keep a safe distance when driving near cyclists.
questions.explanation: Drivers must be careful around cyclists. Always keep a safe distance between your vehicle and a cyclist.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about upcoming dangers or special conditions. Round signs are only used to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: Like alcohol and other drugs, being drowsy can:
questions.explanation: Not sleeping enough causes poor driving. Like drugs and alcohol, drowsiness slows your reaction time, reduces awareness, and impairs judgment.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn left only after you stop.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: Signs with a red circle and line through a black symbol mean that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.
